info.title: Projects 27 core API
info.description: One contract for the web, iOS (Swift) and Android (Dart/Flutter) clients. Amounts are decimal strings in IDR, never JSON numbers. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: Create an account with a personal entity in IDR and the starting chart of accounts
Sign in. Web clients receive an HttpOnly session cookie; native clients (iOS, Android) receive a bearer token
Generate an authenticator secret (RFC 6238); two-factor stays off until enabled
Turn on two-factor sign-in with a current code

get.summary: The signed-in user and the entities they belong to

post.summary: Record an income, expense or transfer; posts a balanced two-line entry (or submits it where approval is required)

200.description: Same idempotency key and body: the existing entry

post.summary: Post a general balanced journal entry

200.description: Same idempotency key and body: the existing entry

post.summary: Correct a posted entry with a linked reversing entry; the original is never edited
Post a submitted entry; the approver must not be its preparer
Reject a submitted entry with a reason

get.summary: A report with self-checks. monthly-recap needs year and month; monthly-trend needs year and month (the last month) and optional months (1 to 24, default 12); income-statement needs from and to; trial-balance and balance-sheet need asOf
Months that were closed or reopened

post.summary: Close a month: no pending approvals, all report checks pass, snapshots stored with SHA-256 hashes
Reopen a closed month with a reason (audited)

get.summary: Frozen reports of a closed month with their hashes recomputed for cross-checking
Recompute the entity's hash-chained audit trail

post.summary: Validate a CSV or XLSX file and mark rows already imported, without posting anything
Post every valid row that was not imported before; each row has a stable idempotency key

get.summary: The same report as an Excel workbook; same query parameters as the JSON report

200.description: Excel workbook (Office Open XML): the report, its self-checks and, for snapshots, a Verifikasi sheet with the SHA-256 hash

get.summary: A closed month's frozen report as Excel, with its hash for cross-checking

200.description: Excel workbook (Office Open XML): the report, its self-checks and, for snapshots, a Verifikasi sheet with the SHA-256 hash

post.summary: Read the header row and the first five data rows of a CSV or XLSX file, to choose the column mapping
Turn a spoken or typed Indonesian sentence into a transaction draft for the capture form. Clients do speech recognition on the device and send the text. Nothing is posted.

examples: beli nasi padang 35 ribu pakai gopay kemarin

post.summary: After Simpan, report which filled fields the person changed. Feeds the real-use quality report; only the draft's author can review it, once.

get.summary: Real-use quality of capture: share of saved forms the person did not correct, and per field how often the filled value was kept, with 95% Wilson intervals; overall and per method (AI or rules).

bearerAuth.description: Native apps: the token from POST /v1/auth/login with client "native"

cookieAuth.name: p27_session
cookieAuth.description: Web app: HttpOnly cookie set by POST /v1/auth/login with client "web"

Amount.description: Exact decimal string in IDR with two decimals (ISO 4217: 2 minor units), for example "125000.50". Never a JSON number.

NativeSession.description: Store the token in the iOS Keychain or Android Keystore; send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Valid 30 days, revocable.

WebSession.description: The session is in the HttpOnly p27_session cookie (12 hours). State-changing requests must come from an allowed Origin.

amount.description: Non-negative decimal string with at most two decimals, for example "125000" or "125000.50".

accountId.description: income or expense account; for a transfer, the account that receives the money

fundingAccountId.description: asset or liability account the money comes from or goes to

idempotencyKey.description: Send a new random key per user action; retries with the same key and body return the same entry

debit.description: Non-negative decimal string with at most two decimals, for example "125000" or "125000.50".

ImportRequest.description: The first row of the file is the header; mapping names the header of each column. Send at most 5000 data rows and 8 MiB.

content.description: CSV text, or the XLSX file base64-encoded

defaults.description: Account codes used when a row has no account or funding column

CaptureDraft.description: A filled-in, unsaved transaction form. The client shows it for review; the person presses Simpan to post it with POST .../transactions.

draftId.description: Send it back with the review after Simpan.
